Implementation progress: portable identity and first compiler integration are implemented in the working tree.

Implemented
- Named/versioned checked key codecs; nominal typed entity and link spaces; uniqueness checks without source-row equality; separate DataRevision and PlanRevision; compact target series; exact/count/representative/partial/deferred membership capabilities.
- InteractionCompiler compiles ordinary homogeneous layers, extracts metadata before requested provenance is released, and routes typed target groups through existing Grob/Device annotations. Lean point batches keep one wrapper; summary center/interval grobs share one target. No source-row retention is forced by interaction metadata.
- Default and explicit membership retention, schema/namespace/canonical encoding failures, stale membership revisions, deterministic entity identity after reorder/filter, and explicit unsupported-capability errors.
- Facet and flipped-coordinate tests compare complete device drawings against ordinary compilation after removing only interaction routing annotations.

Verified
Repository formatting applied only to the six implementation/test files listed below. sbt coreJVM/test passed 406 tests; coreJS/test passed 401 tests. This includes 25 new interaction tests, independent permutation expectations, a 10,000-point one-wrapper case, and existing compiler/provenance/core regressions. Runtime used Scala 3.3.8 with Homebrew Java 25.0.1; supported JDK/Scala matrices and compatibility are NOT yet proven.

These are uncommitted working-tree changes; exact file digests follow.

Remaining in this child
Independent-layer typed source bindings, an explicit extension-geom target-lowering adapter, linked grouping-key bindings, interaction-aware composition/namespace handling, and full compatibility evidence are still outstanding. Current homogeneous compilation deliberately rejects independent row types; extension geoms fail rather than inventing target layout. Axis/guide/theme target coverage belongs to widget coverage and is not implemented here. Typed event subscriptions, runtime state, picking, widgets, gestures, browser/native verification, and the rest of the epic are not implemented.

Next implementation step
Generalize source bindings around the actual PlotLayer row-type witness and add explicit custom target-lowering declarations; preserve the current ordinary-plot API and compact batches. Keep source-data and compiled-geometry revisions separate. A single checked erasure recovery currently sits in InteractionCompiler.attachLayer, justified only by checking every PlotLayer.Inherited constructor for this exact compilation. Do not extend that cast to independent layers without their own witness. Existing built-in target grouping validates output cardinalities and does not parse grob names.
